user.title: Add a car
user.description: Configure one car. Add the integration again for another car.

data_description.event_titles: Enter complete event titles, one per line or separated by commas. For example: TILL JOBBET. Spaces are allowed.
data_description.event_keywords: Enter words, phrases or tags, one per line or separated by commas. Any single title or word/tag can match. Capitalization is ignored.

error.missing_calendar_rule: Enter a title, word or tag for the selected calendar.
error.duplicate_switch: This switch is already used by another car.
